# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta16

This beta enables the Navimower 0.4.5-beta27 semantic prepared-live contract.

## Changed

- Prefer the content-addressed `live_semantic_route` resource when the integration advertises it.
- Request `prepared_live_semantic_tail_only=1` so the normal Map API can omit the full raw live trail when the semantic backbone and short tail are aligned.
- Render active cutting and transit/travel as separate semantic route classes in Single and Multi mower views.
- Keep the cutting route at the configured trail opacity, matching the current-cycle mowed-area opacity.
- Render transit/travel as a thin centerline instead of the full cutting-width trail, so transit no longer visually cuts a mowing-width strip through already mowed areas.
- Retain the beta15 prepared-live/raw route path as the compatibility fallback for older integrations, missing semantic resources, session mismatches, and semantic-tail fallback cases.

## Scope

This beta intentionally avoids unrelated visual changes. Selected-session glow, legend styling, colors, and broader appearance work remain unchanged so the semantic live-route behavior can be field-tested independently.
